archetype: Understanding one thing thoroughly wants a focused readout with supporting context in a dense column, not air. Content shape: 7 information item(s), numeric readouts absent, spatial request not stated.; focal-role: The archetype names what the eye is for, so the plan's focal can be checked against it.; rejected:editorial-focus: Stated so the composition is a decision, not the absence of one.; visual-intent.density: From the archetype's density rule for this decision figure and content shape; overridden by a composition descriptor when the direction states one.; visual-intent.rhythm: The archetype's whitespace contract; overridden by a composition descriptor when the direction states one.; visual-intent.alignment: Numeric scanning rewards strict grid alignment; tune up alignment when values update in place.

discoveries: Type-role contract: the screen name takes the title role, the decision context takes the subtitle, each information item takes its natural role (eyebrow for metadata, label for chrome-ish captions, body for prose, code for identifiers), and status states take the label role at legible size.

Acceptance criteria declared: no label below 11px; uppercase reserved for eyebrows; one spacing rhythm step between sibling regions; body columns around 75 characters. Measured on rendered evidence when screenshot critique runs (issue #22 phase 2).
Composition archetype contract: data-dense (planner runs after this and derives regions; the plan is reviewed against this contract).

Field conflict on 'visual-intent.rhythm': 'visual-intent.rhythm'='generous' from brief-art-direction, 'visual-intent.rhythm'='even' from composition-strategy overridden by brief-art-direction's decision; overridden decision kept in the trail.

Self-tension inside 'brief-art-direction': two manner words claimed 'visual-intent.depth' ('subtle', then 'subtle'). The earlier word's claim was overridden; the tension is also in the direction skill's own notes.

rejectedAlternatives.reason: Outranked on the weighted total (6.3 vs 6.72). a story over time must keep its order visible; a grid erases exactly what the brief is about (inspect decision, model name and publisher,run cost per task,latency p99,quality verdict,fit state on target device,recommended last mile,alternative models ranked item(s)). taskFit: 8 — ranked affinity for the 'inspect' decision class. informationHierarchy: 9 — 7 information item(s) against a family that packs them into comparable columns and rows. densityScanability: 7 — how 7 item(s) sit in this family: rows/columns absorb inventory.

Outranked on the weighted total (6.18 vs 6.72). arranging or locating things is itself the task, so the composition has to be a place rather than a list (inspect decision, model name and publisher,run cost per task,latency p99,quality verdict,fit state on target device,recommended last mile,alternative models ranked item(s)). taskFit: 6 — ranked affinity for the 'inspect' decision class, plus the brief's stated relationships that this family draws. relationshipClarity: 9 — 1 stated relationship item(s): 'latency p99' — drawn, not listed. informationHierarchy: 8 — 7 information item(s) against a spatial field: dense past ~8 nodes, individual labels stop being readable in place. densityScanability: 6 — how 7 item(s) sit in this family: spaced nodes need room per label.

Outranked on the weighted total (6.12 vs 6.72). an instrument keeps the state of the whole at eye level and the object under it, so intervention happens where the evidence is (inspect decision, model name and publisher,run cost per task,latency p99,quality verdict,fit state on target device,recommended last mile,alternative models ranked item(s)). taskFit: 7 — ranked affinity for the 'inspect' decision class. informationHierarchy: 9 — 7 information item(s) against a family that packs them into comparable columns and rows. densityScanability: 7 — how 7 item(s) sit in this family: rows/columns absorb inventory.

Outranked on the weighted total (6.06 vs 6.72). comparing needs both things on screen at once and aligned, or the comparison collapses into memory (inspect decision, model name and publisher,run cost per task,latency p99,quality verdict,fit state on target device,recommended last mile,alternative models ranked item(s)). taskFit: 8 — ranked affinity for the 'inspect' decision class. informationHierarchy: 8 — 7 information item(s) against a family that aligns fewer, taller columns. densityScanability: 6 — how 7 item(s) sit in this family: rows/columns absorb inventory.

Outranked on the weighted total (5.32 vs 6.72). when the brief has one thing to say, the composition must say it first — air, scale and a single focal region (inspect decision, model name and publisher,run cost per task,latency p99,quality verdict,fit state on target device,recommended last mile,alternative models ranked item(s)). taskFit: 7 — ranked affinity for the 'inspect' decision class. informationHierarchy: 4 — 7 information item(s) against a single-focus read: past a handful, the focus is a claim, not a fact. densityScanability: 6 — how 7 item(s) sit in this family: a focused read needs few items to stay a read.
